Opaque dark jade material cores with luminous mint/emerald edges and native soft alpha only at glow edges. No gold recolor, no pale fog covering the full cell.
EXACTLY 4 columns by 3 rows, 12 SQUARE cells, ordered left-to-right/top-to-bottom, ideal2048x1536. Fixed camera and visual anchor, generous15% EMPTY transparent padding around every frame. All tips, embers and whiskers completely inside their own cell. Each frame must have genuinely evolving shapes; not repeated scaled copies.
SEQUENCE: Twelve-frame IAIDO DRAW-CUT ENERGY.1 thin compressed green line;2-3 tension curls into a narrow arc;4-6 one sharp emerald crescent cuts toward screen-right with a coherent darker dragon-scale spine and hot pale-mint cutting edge;7-9 the arc fractures into fine emerald fragments;10-12 green filaments disperse completely. Elegant precise single cut, not a blunt circle or explosion. No physical katana; no human. Real evolving silhouette and trailing fragments in each frame.
